title: David’s Victories

questions.question: Which city did David defeat and take from the hand of the Philistines?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 18:1 (ESV): "...David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and he took Gath and its villages out of the hand of the Philistines."

questions.question: What did the Moabites become to David?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 18:2 (ESV): "And he defeated Moab, and the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute."

questions.question: Who was king of Zobah whom David defeated?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 18:3 (ESV): "David also defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah..."

questions.question: What did David do with the horses?
options: Hamstrung all the chariot horses, but left enough for 100 chariots
questions.correctAnswer: Hamstrung all the chariot horses, but left enough for 100 chariots
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 18:4 (ESV): "...David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but left enough of them for a hundred chariots."

questions.question: Who congratulated David on his victory over Hadadezer?
options: Tou king of Hamath sent his son Hadoram
questions.correctAnswer: Tou king of Hamath sent his son Hadoram
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 18:9-10 (ESV): "When Tou king of Hamath heard... he sent Hadoram his son to King David to ask his health..."

questions.question: What did David do with the silver and gold brought by Hadoram?
options: He dedicated them to the LORD
He gave them to his soldiers
questions.correctAnswer: He dedicated them to the LORD
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 18:11 (ESV): "These also King David dedicated to the LORD..."

questions.question: How many Syrians did David kill when they came to help Hadadezer?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 18:5 (ESV): "...David struck down 22,000 men of the Syrians."

questions.question: Who struck down 18,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 18:12 (ESV): "Abishai the son of Zeruiah killed 18,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt."

questions.question: What was David’s administration characterized by?
options: Justice and equity to all his people
questions.correctAnswer: Justice and equity to all his people
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 18:14 (ESV): "So David reigned over all Israel, and he administered justice and equity to all his people."

questions.question: Who was recorder?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 18:15 (ESV): "...and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;"

questions.question: What material did David take from Tibhath and Cun?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 18:8 (ESV): "And from Tibhath and from Cun... David took very much bronze..."

questions.question: What was made from the bronze taken from Hadadezer’s cities?
options: The bronze sea and the pillars and the vessels of bronze
questions.correctAnswer: The bronze sea and the pillars and the vessels of bronze
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 18:8 (ESV): "...With it Solomon made the bronze sea and the pillars and the vessels of bronze."

questions.question: Who was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 18:17 (ESV): "Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites..."

questions.question: What role did David’s sons have?
options: Chief officials in the service of the king
questions.correctAnswer: Chief officials in the service of the king
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 18:17 (ESV): "...and David's sons were the chief officials in the service of the king."

key_verse_text: So David reigned over all Israel, and he administered justice and equity to all his people.
